_comment: Acceptance criteria for the BagIdea desk auto-signal edge study. RATIFIED BEFORE ANY RESULT EXISTED — the study had not been run, the shadow ledger held zero closed entries, and the backtest data was still downloading. That order is the whole point: a bar set after seeing the outcome is not a bar. Changing any number here after a result is known invalidates the study and requires a new one.
decided_by: CREATOR:2026-07-25 (Tin / aonizai) — ratified in-session, pre-registration, no study result in existence at the time
strategy: bagidea-auto-signal-v1 (analyzeSymbol grade gate + regimeGate longOnly + BE/partial/trail manager, as executed by executeAutoSignal)
also_evaluated: smc-radar-fvg-v1 (plugins/smc-radar/engine.js analyzeAsOf setups) — scored against the SAME criteria, separately, never pooled
symbol: 15-coin universe (BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP DOGE ADA AVAX LINK LTC DOT TRX ATOM NEAR APT) — deliberately 3x the tradeable allowlist

conservative_costs._comment: Deliberately HARSHER than backtest_lite's defaults (0.0004/0.0002/0.0002). A wall that assumes the good case is not a wall. RD-VERDICT lesson #2: transaction cost is the killer.
conservative_costs.funding: REAL Binance USD-M per-symbol series REQUIRED — never fabricated, never zero-substituted; fetched through END+1 day so the exit bar's boundary is covered

liquidation_check._comment: The engine sizes risk-first and is unlevered. Collateral = notional / assumed_leverage_x, set to the desk's live maxLeverage so the estimate matches the tier the strategy would actually run under.

evidence_minimum._comment: The recorded false positive was n=6 (+10.4%/trade, beat the signal-blind control) that went negative at n=20-24 when the universe widened from 5 coins to 15. The prior grade-A measurement was N=14 and the research log itself called it inconclusive. 200 is the number at which a +0.15R claim stops being noise at the observed r_std.

reviewer_checked_also_required._comment: Criteria the machine does NOT auto-check. Every one of them is here because it is the specific test that killed a previous candidate on this desk. A machine VALIDATED_CANDIDATE on the subset above is necessary but NOT sufficient.
reviewer_checked_also_required.t_stat_note: t = r_sharpe * sqrt(n-1), NOT sqrt(n) — metrics_v1._pop_std is a population std. ~12 hypotheses have been tested; at 12 looks P(some |t|>2 by luck) is about 43%, at 2.5 about 14%. This is the multiple-comparisons tax the desk has earned.
reviewer_checked_also_required.beat_signal_blind_control_note: Must exceed the 95th percentile of >=200 seeded draws matched on trade COUNT and holding-period distribution, not the mean. Beating the mean is exactly what regime-Donchian did immediately before it died.
reviewer_checked_also_required.beat_gate_only_control_note: Control C2 keeps the regime gate and every risk gate but discards the scanner grade. If C2 matches the strategy, the edge is the regime gate and not the signal — that is the isolation that killed the last lead.
reviewer_checked_also_required.universe_expansion_rule: The 15-coin pooled result must satisfy every criterion on its own, and the 5-coin result must not exceed the 15-coin result by more than 2x. The 15-coin number is the headline; the 5-coin number is reported beside it as what a narrow study would have claimed.
reviewer_checked_also_required.forming_bar_note: Closed-bar and forming-bar replay must agree in SIGN. The live loop decides every 30s against a forming candle; the engine enforces closed-bar next-bar execution. Disagreement means the result is an artifact of cadence, not an edge.
reviewer_checked_also_required.peak_from_note: The trail is simulated with peak_from=high (optimistic; the live monitor never sees intrabar wicks) and peak_from=close (pessimistic; a 30s poll only sees closes). Truth is between them. Sign disagreement means the execution cannot be modelled honestly.
reviewer_checked_also_required.data_provenance_required: mainnet archive from data.binance.vision, checksum-verified, dataset sha256 pinned in the run manifest, zero synthesized candles. Testnet klines are NOT admissible as evidence.
reviewer_checked_also_required.golden_parity_required: A week of the live shadow ledger must replay through the harness in forming-bar mode and reproduce the same fired signals and the same block reasons. Until this passes, no verdict is publishable.

structural_rules.no_go_is_the_default: If any criterion is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE the verdict is NO-GO. There is no such thing as 'passed the ones we could measure'.
structural_rules.a_full_pass_is_not_a_switch_flip: GO means: run shadow mode for 30 days or >=30 signals, whichever is later; if forward expectancy sits within 1 SE of the backtest, the owner MAY THEN consider flipping autoTradeSignal. Ratifying these thresholds authorizes nothing about that switch.
structural_rules.no_go_closes_the_line: The correct response to NO-GO is to close the hypothesis and record it, not to retune parameters. Re-running with new parameters until something passes is the noise-mining the desk has already warned itself about.
structural_rules.changing_a_number_invalidates_the_study: These were set before any result existed. Editing one afterwards means the study must be re-run from a fresh holdout.

calibration_self_test: These numbers reject the desk's own best-ever result. Regime-gated Donchian at n=6 — which beat the signal-blind control out-of-sample before dying at n=20-24 — fails the minimum-n criterion alone, before anyone looks at its return. A threshold set that would have admitted the known false positive would be worthless.
